## Summary / feature

What behavior does this change introduce? Link the design issue or existing contract.

## Isolation and security boundary

- [ ] Tenant/resource ownership and trust boundaries identified, or marked not applicable with rationale
- [ ] AuthN/AuthZ, capability scope, and cross-tenant negative cases reviewed
- [ ] Limits, integer overflow, retry/replay, lifecycle and failure recovery reviewed
- [ ] No credentials, access tokens, PII, or production customer data introduced

## Validation

- [ ] Unit/integration/negative tests added, or justified
- [ ] Exact commit SHA and toolchain/build provenance included
- [ ] CI result linked; skipped/pending checks are not described as passing
- [ ] Rollback, compatibility and release constraints described

## Readiness

State whether this PR is a **reference contract**, experimental implementation, or production candidate. Drafts and CI-only mirrors are not production-ready by implication.
